records.text:
Then all the mighty ones went | to the seats of judgment,
the most holy gods, | and took counsel together
on who should create | the peoples of the dwarves
from the bloody surf | and the bones of the Blue One.

records.text:
They made many in human likeness,
dwarves in the earth, | as Durinn said.
